title: Prompt Injection as Role Confusion
description: Research by Charles Ye, Jasmine Cui, and Dylan Hadfield-Menell reveals that LLMs cannot reliably distinguish between their own privileged text and untrusted user input. Models take text style more seriously than actual content, leading to concerning jailbreaks. 'Destyling' text reduces attack success from 61% to 10%, suggesting role confusion is a key challenge for prompt injection defense.
author: Simon Willison (citing Charles Ye, Jasmine Cui, Dylan Hadfield-Menell)

title: Porting the Moebius 0.2B Image Inpainting Model to Browser
description: Successfully ported the 0.2B parameter Moebius image inpainting model to run in-browser using WebGPU, enabling image inpainting without server-side processing. Demonstrates advancing browser capabilities for ML model deployment.
author: Simon Willison

title: sqlite-utils 4.0rc1 Adds Migrations and Nested Transactions
description: Major update to sqlite-utils Python library and CLI tool introduces migrations and nested transaction support for working with SQLite databases, providing higher-level operations for complex table transformations.
author: Simon Willison

title: Temporary Cloudflare Accounts for AI Agents
description: Cloudflare introduces temporary worker deployments for AI agents - deploy applications with `npx wrangler deploy --temporary` without creating an account. Projects stay live for 60 minutes and can be claimed for persistence. Demonstrates evolving infrastructure patterns for AI agent deployments.
author: Simon Willison

title: Datasette Apps: Host Custom HTML Applications Inside Datasette
description: Launch of new datasette-apps plugin enabling custom HTML application hosting within Datasette, with iframe sandboxing and CSP controls. Provides new patterns for building AI-assisted data applications with proper security boundaries.
author: Simon Willison
